title: sticker-shelf index.json
description: One entry per sticker image in the same folder. Managed by sticker.py; safe to edit by hand (entries without an id get one on next load).

next_id.description: Next number to hand out. Numbers are never reused.

next_group_id.description: Next group id to hand out.

groups.description: Groups in the user's order. Items store only the group id; deleting a group makes its items ungrouped (group: null).

file.description: Image file name inside the sticker folder.

desc.description: One line that lets someone find it without seeing it.

aliases.description: Old names; kept on rename so old messages still show the image.

group.description: Group id from `groups`, or null for ungrouped. Older files may hold a group name; it is migrated on load.
